about: Chaos Unison's charged B in both engines for Team ProtoMan's NapalmSoul (docs/game/team-protoman.md, unit 8; src/emu/soulpower.c's team_chaos): NapalmSoul held with Chaos Unison (BN5's flags 0000 and 0236, his flag entry written in BN5's ROM copy and set, souls5; BN6's souls6 bit 21), a deck of DarkMetr F (BN5's 195, BN6's 217: the DarkChip of his kind, Fire) given up on the first Custom screen: Chaos Unison, its turns 1. B held 75 frames from t60: charged by his chaos power's time at level 0 (BN5's 0x0801CA68 row 0x37: 70 frames, where Team Colonel's rows hold 40), then the phases' cycle of its row (BN5's 0x08010648: 42 frames, phase 2 its first 21), released in phase 2: the Soul's DarkChip attack (BN5's power attack 0x37, 0x0800FA72, DarkMetr through the chip writer; BN6's 0xB7, a stub of ours at SOULS_TEAM_CHAOS that hands the writer the registry's 217), its meteors run by BN5's code moved (the misc family's subfamily 0x11, Astroid's controller), the level 1. The foe BN5's CanladEX held paralysed at (5,2) (hold: each game's own status step), as the chips' specs hold it. MegaMan's side's chip list given in BN5 (dschips: three Cannons) and BN6's written from it (dslist), so a Dark Soul would play the same chips in both. Released at t137, DarkMetr's meteors (the third kind's 0x56) fall from t138, one every 10 frames, the first landing at t184 and shaking the camera, whose draws BN5 makes from its first RNG word and BN6 from its second (legit.json's rng, shake): rng=replay pairs them, as chip_darkmetr's does, BN5's unison's own frames' per-frame draws at t1 read as the engine's (legit.json's masks, the engine's per-frame draws while the battle's clock holds, replayed); the third deletes CanladEX at t204 and the battle ends with him at t239, his deletion's last frames read in BN6's terms (legit.json's maps, deletion_end). Every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it.
